name: mcp-sepolia
description: Pays a Request Network Secure Payment on Ethereum Sepolia (local mnemonic or remote Turnkey signer)

mnemonic.title: Mnemonic (BIP-39)
mnemonic.description: 12/24-word phrase for the Sepolia wallet. Leave empty if you are using Turnkey below. Use a dedicated testnet mnemonic, never a mainnet seed.

turnkey_api_public_key.title: Turnkey API Public Key
turnkey_api_public_key.description: Enables the remote Turnkey signer (takes priority over the mnemonic) when set.

turnkey_api_private_key.title: Turnkey API Private Key
turnkey_api_private_key.description: Private key of the Turnkey API key associated with the public key above.

turnkey_organization_id.title: Turnkey Organization ID
turnkey_organization_id.description: Turnkey organization (or sub-organization) that owns the signing wallet.

turnkey_sign_with.title: Turnkey Sign With
turnkey_sign_with.description: Wallet address, private key ID, or wallet account ID to use for signing.

rn_client_id.title: Request Network Client ID
rn_client_id.description: Client ID that created the Secure Payment to be paid.
